description: Bulls and Cows — guess the secret 4-digit number from A (bulls) and B (cows) feedback.

faqs.a: A means bulls: right digit in the right place. B means cows: right digit but in the wrong place. So “1A2B” = one digit perfectly placed, two more correct digits misplaced.
faqs.q: What do A and B mean?

faqs.a: Yes — every game uses 4 different digits, and the number never starts with 0.
Start with 4 distinct digits (e.g. 1234) to maximize information, then use the A/B counts to eliminate. With perfect play it takes about 5–6 tries on average.

howto: Press “New game” to get a secret 4-digit number.
Type your guess (4 different digits) and press “Guess”.
Read the A/B feedback: A = right digit, right spot; B = right digit, wrong spot.
Get 4A0B to win — fewest guesses wins.
title: Bulls and Cows
